candidates.name: Big Hollow Project
candidates.from: EMRT Mainline 2 interconnect, MP 415.5, Monroe County, Illinois
candidates.to: Big Hollow Energy Center, Jefferson County, Missouri

evidence.note: 9.6-mile 20-inch lateral to serve Ameren's Big Hollow gas plant; FERC review
Missouri PSC approved Big Hollow plant, in part to serve expected data centers

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row named Big Hollow; P0162 Mississippi River Transmission is the parent system only. Starts in Illinois, ends in Missouri. Data center tie is indirect (utility plant justified partly by data center load). Length 9.6 mi (about 15.4 km).

candidates.name: Bakken East Pipeline (Ellendale data center branch)

evidence.note: Bakken East planned to serve power generation and data center growth
Applied Digital Ellendale site sits on the receiving end of a planned branch from Bakken East

candidates.why_maybe_new: Matches P8096 (Bakken East Pipeline), matched_existing: DataCenter tag lead for that row. The Ellendale branch itself may be a separate short lateral; no length or binding supply contract found.
